description: The key each hotstring category stores its section order under, hotstrings.order_overrides.<id>. A category of a language folder is keyed by its group id, <folder>_<stem>, never by its file stem: the French and neutral autocorrection files are both autocorrection.toml.

vectors.name: neutral autocorrection is keyed by its file stem
neutral magic key is keyed by its file stem
distances reduction is keyed by its file stem
sfbs reduction is keyed by its file stem
rolls is keyed by its file stem
dynamic hotstrings are keyed by their category name
french autocorrection is keyed by its group id, not its file stem
french magic key is keyed by its group id, not its file stem
